newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Barely steady European feeds start slow.
newsitem.headline: Barely steady European feeds start slow.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market opened quietly this morning with sellers offering most products unchanged to a few dollar lower, following last night's barely steady Chicago soymeal futures, market sources said.
"There was hardly any buying interest seen ahead of the weekend. The barely changed prices and dollar were no incentives to hurry onto the marketplace," one broker said.
A few bids were seen in Argentine sunmeal pellets at around three dollars under sellers' ideas, but no trades were reported during the initial stages of the market.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
